newsitem.title: USA: Stock prices drop; jump in housing starts fuels Fed rate fears.
newsitem.headline: Stock prices drop; jump in housing starts fuels Fed rate fears.

text.p: Stocks ended another volatile session with sharp losses Tuesday as news that housing starts in February racked up their biggest increase in nearly three years heightened speculation that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next week to slow the economy's growth.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed 58.92 points lower at 6,896.56 after trading briefly with a loss of more than 100 points. In the broader market, declining issues beat advances by 2-1 on active volume of 471 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
